attrs.text: unsupported_link: The why-chain cites a computed NOx potential to emit of 1,067 tpy as the basis for the Title V major-source determination, but the only verified evidence is the regulatory threshold (100 tpy). The computation depends on unverified assumptions: 121 diesel generators of 2500 kW each, 500 hours/year operation, and a Tier 2 NOx emission factor of 6.4 g/kWh. No quote or source verifies these assumptions.
